title: Written Estimates and Line Authorization — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Estimate rule of Service Accounts and Repair Orders.** Customer-pay work on a concern line expected to exceed the tier's written-estimate threshold is done only after the customer authorizes a written estimate for that line. The authorization is the customer's own decision, recorded as a repair authorization with the decision authorized. Customer-pay work above the estimate threshold is billed only on a line the customer has authorized.

**Fleet accounts.** A fleet account authorizes in advance any concern line up to the tier's fleet pre-authorized amount and needs no separate decision below that amount.

**Declined lines.** A declined line is not worked and is not billed beyond its diagnostic fee.

**Retired clause.** The clause under which the customer-pay labor and parts billed on an authorized line could exceed the authorized estimate amount by at most the tier's estimate overage tolerance of it, with anything billed beyond that tolerance without a further authorization credited back as an estimate overage credit, is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for estimate overage credits.

## Authorization: what the records must show
Whether a line is authorized is read from the repair authorization records for that repair order and concern line, and the decision recorded there, not from the customer's statement. An authorization on another line or another repair order does not authorize this line.

| Expected customer-pay amount on the line | Authorized decision on record for this repair order and line | May the work be billed? |
|---|---|---|
| Above the threshold | Yes | Yes |
| Above the threshold | No, or declined | No (a declined line is billed no more than its diagnostic fee) |

**Hypothetical.** With a 25.00 threshold, a line expected at 310.00 needs the customer's authorized estimate before the work; on a fleet account whose pre-authorized amount is 750.00, a line expected at 610.00 needs no separate decision.

superseded_clauses: The customer-pay labor and parts billed on an authorized line may exceed the authorized estimate_amount by at most estimate_overage_tolerance_pct of it; anything billed beyond that tolerance without a further authorization is credited back as credit_reason estimate_overage.
